build_multi_relation_embedder: build a MultiRelationEmbedder model from a ConfigSchema using make_model to score graph edges
create_comparator: create a DotComparator CosComparator L2Comparator or SquaredL2Comparator to score pairs of embedding vectors
create_simple_embedding: create a SimpleEmbedding module with a weight parameter to look up entity embeddings by index
create_featurized_embedding: create a FeaturizedEmbedding module to compute entity embeddings via embedding bag aggregation
override_model_config: override specific config attributes on a MultiRelationEmbedder temporarily using the override_model context manager
